description:
93 agentic MCP tools + 49 specialist agents for every major AI CLI — self-learning, no API keys.

Veto gives Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, and JetBrains a council of specialist agents, persistent cross-platform memory, a self-learning router, CI/CD gates, and dependency-hallucination + decision-drift guards — all powered by your existing AI subscription. No separate API keys, no extra billing.

**Highlights**

- **Council debate** — multi-agent GREEN/YELLOW/RED verdicts on risky changes (LLM-backed via MCP Sampling, with deterministic fallback)
- **Cross-platform memory & session handoff** — save on Claude, resume on Gemini or Codex; nothing needs re-explaining
- **Self-learning router** — improves task routing from recorded outcomes
- **Guards & gates** — CI gate, diff review, secrets scan, dependency-hallucination verification, decision-drift enforcement
- **Compact mode** — advertise 9 tools instead of 93 and save ~16K context tokens; every tool stays callable

**Links**: [GitHub](https://github.com/jigyasudham/veto) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jigyasudham/veto)

tool_signatures.name: veto_a11y_advisor
tool_signatures.description: Analyzes UI components (React, Vue, HTML) for accessibility (a11y) compliance (WCAG) and provides actionable fix recommendations.

tool_signatures.name: veto_adr
tool_signatures.description: Converts a veto_council_debate result into a MADR-format Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Writes to docs/decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md if project_dir is provided. Returns the ADR markdown content.

tool_signatures.name: veto_agent_plan
tool_signatures.description: Gets a domain-expert execution plan from a specific worker agent. Returns approach, ordered steps, checklist, patterns, and pitfalls for the task.

tool_signatures.name: veto_api_contract
tool_signatures.description: Analyzes API endpoints and generates/verifies API contracts (e.g. OpenAPI or TypeScript types) to ensure front/back compatibility.

tool_signatures.name: veto_audit_log
tool_signatures.description: Queryable log of every council verdict, decision, and session event. Filter by session, agent, verdict, or date. Essential for tracing what happened and why.

tool_signatures.name: veto_autosave_status
tool_signatures.description: Returns the current auto-save state: whether a context is cached, the threshold, the last auto-save time, and the session ID.

tool_signatures.name: veto_benchmark
tool_signatures.description: Compares two competing approaches by running a full council debate on each in parallel, then returns a structured winner analysis with verdict, confidence delta, warning counts, and council reasoning. Use when you have two valid options and want an unbiased council judgment before committing.

tool_signatures.name: veto_bundle_advisor
tool_signatures.description: Accepts a webpack-format stats JSON (

tool_signatures.name: veto_call
tool_signatures.description: Invokes any Veto catalog tool by name with the given arguments. Use veto_find_tools first to discover the tool name and its argument schema.

tool_signatures.name: veto_changelog
tool_signatures.description: Generates a structured changelog from git commits since the last tag, grouped by conventional commit type (feat, fix, refactor, etc.). Pure local git — no external calls.

tool_signatures.name: veto_ci_gate
tool_signatures.description: CI/CD pipeline gate. Runs code review + security scan + secrets scan on a git diff and returns a structured pass/warn/fail verdict with exit code. Ready for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.

tool_signatures.name: veto_clone_detector
tool_signatures.description: Scans the project for duplicated code blocks or structural clones. Returns grouped findings and refactoring suggestions.

tool_signatures.name: veto_code_review
tool_signatures.description: Runs the Code Reviewer agent on a single snippet or file you pass directly. Returns scored findings (complexity, error handling, magic numbers, nesting, dead code) with severity and fixes. Pass file_path to surface findings as VS Code inline diagnostics (squiggles). For reviewing changed files across a git diff, use veto_diff_review instead.

tool_signatures.name: veto_commit_message
tool_signatures.description: Generates a conventional-commit message from staged changes (git diff --cached). Returns type, scope, subject, and body following the Conventional Commits specification.

tool_signatures.name: veto_compose_agents
tool_signatures.description: Creates a custom meta-agent by composing existing agents into a specialized pipeline.

tool_signatures.name: veto_context_status
tool_signatures.description: Returns the context window usage for a saved session — tokens used, % of platform limit consumed, and whether to compress or hand off before the window fills.

tool_signatures.name: veto_continue
tool_signatures.description: Restores a saved session on any platform. TRIGGER: when the user types

tool_signatures.name: veto_council_debate
tool_signatures.description: Runs the Veto Council — 7 specialist agents debate your task and return a GREEN/YELLOW/RED/DEADLOCK verdict. For full LLM-backed analysis on any platform (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI) with no API keys: (1) call with task only → get instant deterministic result + llm_upgrade.debate_prompt; (2) reason as all 7 agents using the prompt, then call again with agent_responses → get the LLM-backed verdict.

tool_signatures.name: veto_dead_code
tool_signatures.description: Project-scope dead code detector: exported symbols no other project file references (package entry points counted as public API), runs of commented-out code, and TODO/FIXME markers — all found deterministically — plus an LLM judgement of which are safe to delete.

tool_signatures.name: veto_debt_register
tool_signatures.description: Analyzes code quality + git commit frequency to produce a ranked technical debt register. High-churn + low-quality files are highest priority. Returns a prioritized list with debt type, location, and suggested agent.

tool_signatures.name: veto_decisions
tool_signatures.description: Decision-drift enforcement: records architectural decisions as machine-checkable constraints, then flags diffs that violate them. AI assistants forget decisions and re-litigate them sessions later — record

tool_signatures.name: veto_delegate
tool_signatures.description: Delegates a subtask to a specialist agent and returns only a compact summary — not the full output. Use when orchestrating multi-step work and you need an agent\

tool_signatures.name: veto_dep_advisor
tool_signatures.description: Reads package.json (using the installed or package-lock version of each dependency) or requirements.txt, queries OSV.dev (free, no key) for known vulnerabilities in those exact versions, and returns a risk-ranked upgrade plan with breaking-change flags.

tool_signatures.name: veto_dep_verify
tool_signatures.description: Dependency-hallucination guard: verifies proposed package names against the live registry (npm, PyPI, crates.io) BEFORE install. Checks existence, age, monthly downloads, version history, deprecation, and typo-distance from popular packages. Catches hallucinated names and slopsquatting/typosquat risks. Call this whenever an AI suggests installing a package you have not used before.

tool_signatures.name: veto_diagram
tool_signatures.description: Generates a Mermaid architecture diagram of the project. Returns diagram text ready to paste into GitHub, Notion, or any Mermaid renderer.

tool_signatures.name: veto_diff_review
tool_signatures.description: Reviews a git diff — runs code review, security scan, and secrets scan in parallel across all changed files. Returns a structured verdict (pass/warn/fail), per-file findings, and a CI-ready summary. Pass diff directly or let Veto read it from project_dir automatically.

tool_signatures.name: veto_discover
tool_signatures.description: Scans a project directory and builds a rich context map: git state, tech stack, file structure, dependencies, and key config files. Stores the result in Veto memory so agents always have accurate project context. Call this once per project or after major structural changes.

tool_signatures.name: veto_doc_gen
tool_signatures.description: Reads a source file and generates JSDoc/TSDoc/docstring comments for all public APIs. Returns the annotated file content.

tool_signatures.name: veto_docs_fetch
tool_signatures.description: Fetches current, version-accurate documentation for any npm, PyPI, or crates.io package and returns it for injection into agent context. Eliminates hallucinated APIs. Results are cached for 24 hours.

tool_signatures.name: veto_drift_check
tool_signatures.description: Compounding-error checkpoint: queries the session\

tool_signatures.name: veto_env_setup
tool_signatures.description: Finds the environment variables the code actually reads and the project\

tool_signatures.name: veto_execute_parallel
tool_signatures.description: Runs multiple worker agents simultaneously via Promise.all. Use to get domain expert input from several agents in one round-trip — e.g. coder + tester + security-scanner all planning the same feature together.

tool_signatures.name: veto_explain
tool_signatures.description: Explains a file or raw text. Pass file_path to explain a source file (read by Veto), or text to explain an error message, stack trace, or compiler output. Files go to the coder specialist, raw text to the debugger specialist.

tool_signatures.name: veto_find_tools
tool_signatures.description: Searches the full Veto catalog (93 tools: agents, reviews, advisors, generators, memory, learning, git, workflow) by keyword and returns matching tool schemas. Compact mode exposes only core tools up front — call this first to discover the right tool, then invoke it via veto_call.

tool_signatures.name: veto_flag_auditor
tool_signatures.description: SDK-agnostic feature flag auditor — detects LaunchDarkly/Unleash SDK calls AND custom if(flags.X) patterns. Classifies flags as: actively toggled / candidate for removal / orphaned.

tool_signatures.name: veto_full_review
tool_signatures.description: Full pre-ship review: runs code review + security scan + secrets scan + quality analysis in parallel, then returns a combined verdict (pass/warn/fail). Use before any merge or deploy when you want richer output than veto_diff_review alone.

tool_signatures.name: veto_git_blame
tool_signatures.description: Returns ownership and contribution history for a file or directory — total commits, contributor list with commit counts, and last-modified metadata. Uses local git history: instant, zero network.

tool_signatures.name: veto_handoff
tool_signatures.description: Saves the current session and returns step-by-step instructions to continue on another AI platform (Gemini or Codex). TRIGGER: when the user types

tool_signatures.name: veto_health
tool_signatures.description: Returns a live health snapshot of the Veto server — DB size, session/memory/pattern counts, uptime, error count, and average council latency.

tool_signatures.name: veto_hitl_checkpoint
tool_signatures.description: Pauses an agentic workflow and returns a structured approval-request the host AI surfaces to the user. The user\

tool_signatures.name: veto_learning_apply
tool_signatures.description: Applies learned tier thresholds to the router based on recorded task outcomes. Requires at least 20 recorded outcomes. The router immediately uses the new thresholds on the next veto_route_task call.

tool_signatures.name: veto_learning_stats
tool_signatures.description: Returns the self-learning router dashboard: tier distribution, per-agent quality stats, suggested threshold adjustments, and council insights. Use to understand how the router is performing and where to improve.

tool_signatures.name: veto_lint_rules
tool_signatures.description: Reads the project\

tool_signatures.name: veto_local_llm
tool_signatures.description: Routes a task to a local LLM (via Ollama or LM Studio) instead of a cloud provider. Useful for privacy-sensitive data or simple, repetitive tasks.

tool_signatures.name: veto_memory_delete
tool_signatures.description: Deletes a knowledge entry by ID. Use to remove stale or duplicate entries found via veto_memory_search.

tool_signatures.name: veto_memory_export
tool_signatures.description: Exports all local memory (sessions, knowledge, patterns, decisions, project maps) to a portable JSON or Markdown file. Use markdown for a human-readable VETO_MEMORY.md file.

tool_signatures.name: veto_memory_import
tool_signatures.description: Imports memory from a JSON file exported by veto_memory_export on another machine. Merges into local SQLite using INSERT OR IGNORE — existing local rows are never overwritten. Call veto_sessions_list after import to confirm sessions arrived.

tool_signatures.name: veto_memory_search
tool_signatures.description: Searches the local knowledge base for entries matching a query. Call at the start of every task to find prior solutions before solving from scratch.

tool_signatures.name: veto_memory_store
tool_signatures.description: Stores a knowledge entry (solution, pattern, error, reference, or decision) in the local knowledge base for retrieval across sessions. Search before storing to avoid duplicates.

tool_signatures.name: veto_merge_conflict
tool_signatures.description: Analyzes a file with git conflict markers and returns a semantically correct resolution by understanding the intent of both branches.

tool_signatures.name: veto_metrics
tool_signatures.description: Returns a usage dashboard for the current Veto installation — sessions saved, council debates, quality trend, most-used agents, and knowledge base stats. Zero cost: pure SQLite reads. Great for a weekly health check.

tool_signatures.name: veto_new_feature
tool_signatures.description: New feature planning pipeline: council governance → execution plan → task DAG, in sequence. Collapses 3 manual tool calls into 1. RED council verdict stops the pipeline early — do not plan what is blocked. Returns council verdict + agent plan + structured task list.

tool_signatures.name: veto_notify_ide
tool_signatures.description: Sends a message to the client as an MCP log notification (action show_message or set_status); whether it is shown is up to the client. MCP gives a server no way to open files or change the client\

tool_signatures.name: veto_onboard
tool_signatures.description: Generates a complete new-developer onboarding guide: setup, architecture, key files, how to run tests, first PR checklist.

tool_signatures.name: veto_openapi_gen
tool_signatures.description: Reads Express/FastAPI/Hono/Fastify route files and generates an OpenAPI 3.1 spec YAML. Returns the spec as a string and optionally writes it to openapi.yaml.

tool_signatures.name: veto_pattern_store
tool_signatures.description: Stores or updates a coding pattern observed in the codebase. Patterns are keyed by category.pattern-name and confidence increases with repeated observation.

tool_signatures.name: veto_patterns_list
tool_signatures.description: Returns stored coding patterns. Filter by prefix to get patterns in a specific category (e.g. prefix=

tool_signatures.name: veto_platform_setup
tool_signatures.description: Returns the exact MCP config and setup steps to connect a specific AI platform to this Veto server.

tool_signatures.name: veto_playwright
tool_signatures.description: Writes a runnable Playwright test (TypeScript) for a browser scenario and says how to run it. Veto does not launch or drive a browser itself.

tool_signatures.name: veto_plugins
tool_signatures.description: Lists all custom agents loaded from ~/.veto/agents/. Drop a .js file there that exports plan(task, context?) to register a new agent available in veto_agent_plan and veto_execute_parallel.

tool_signatures.name: veto_postmortem
tool_signatures.description: Incident description + timeline → blameless postmortem with five-whys RCA, action items, and correlation with past council RED verdicts if available.

tool_signatures.name: veto_pr_description
tool_signatures.description: Generates a complete GitHub PR description (title, summary, change list, test plan, breaking changes) from git diff main...HEAD. Ready to paste into GitHub or post via veto_pr_post.

tool_signatures.name: veto_pr_post
tool_signatures.description: Posts veto_pr_review or veto_diff_review findings to a GitHub PR as one review whose body lists every finding with its location. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable. Returns the review URL.

tool_signatures.name: veto_pr_review
tool_signatures.description: Fetches a GitHub PR diff and runs the full Veto triple-scan (code review + security + secrets). Returns a structured verdict and ready-to-post GitHub review comments. Set GITHUB_TOKEN env var for private repos.

tool_signatures.name: veto_pre_commit
tool_signatures.description: Pre-commit gate: runs secrets scan (hard block on any finding) + code review in parallel on staged changes. Faster than veto_full_review — tuned for commit-time validation. Returns a blocked/warn/pass verdict.

tool_signatures.name: veto_project_map_get
tool_signatures.description: Returns the stored project structure map for a directory. Use to navigate the codebase without scanning the filesystem.

tool_signatures.name: veto_project_map_update
tool_signatures.description: Updates the project structure map for a directory. Call after creating, deleting, or moving files. The map enables fast codebase navigation without filesystem scans.

tool_signatures.name: veto_prompt_optimizer
tool_signatures.description: Scores a prompt for failure modes (vague role, missing output format, injection-prone, no examples) and returns a rewritten version with improvements. Zero API keys needed — uses the local agent loop.

tool_signatures.name: veto_query_advisor
tool_signatures.description: Accepts a SQL query or EXPLAIN ANALYZE output + optional schema → returns rewrite suggestions, CREATE INDEX statements, N+1 detection, and index risk assessment.

tool_signatures.name: veto_rate_status
tool_signatures.description: Returns current request counts and rate limit status for all AI platforms tracked by Veto.

tool_signatures.name: veto_rca
tool_signatures.description: Stack trace or error description → structured root-cause hypothesis with likely introducing commit. Reads the code at the stack trace\

tool_signatures.name: veto_record_outcome
tool_signatures.description: Records a task outcome (quality score) to feed the self-learning router. Call after completing any task. The router auto-applies learned tier thresholds every 20 recorded outcomes (disable via config auto_apply_learning=false); veto_learning_apply forces an update on demand.

tool_signatures.name: veto_release_notes
tool_signatures.description: Generates user-facing release notes from merged commits since the last git tag. Rewrites dev-speak into plain English (fix: race condition → Login is now more reliable).

tool_signatures.name: veto_route_task
tool_signatures.description: Scores a task for complexity (0-100) and returns the optimal tier, model recommendation, and rate status. Use before any substantial task to let the router decide which model to use.

tool_signatures.name: veto_sdd_agent
tool_signatures.description: Spec-Driven Development agent. Provides full SDD loop: spec validation, acceptance criteria generation, and BDD scenario authoring.

tool_signatures.description: Scans text or code for exposed credentials — API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings, private keys. Returns findings with masked values and line numbers. Pass file_path to surface findings as VS Code inline diagnostics.

tool_signatures.description: Runs the Security Scanner (OWASP Top 10) on provided code. Returns vulnerabilities with severity, CWE/OWASP category, and remediation steps. Pass file_path to surface findings as VS Code inline diagnostics.

tool_signatures.name: veto_session_replay

tool_signatures.description: Restores the saved context snapshot of a previous session by ID so you can resume work where it left off. Use veto_sessions_list to find IDs. For the chronological event timeline instead of the working context, use veto_session_replay.

tool_signatures.description: Saves the current session context to SQLite. TRIGGER: when the user types

tool_signatures.description: Lists the most recent saved sessions. Use query to search by summary, context, tags, or project path.

tool_signatures.description: Returns the whole Veto state an editor HUD / statusline needs in ONE read-only call: latest session, latest council verdict, top learned patterns, per-platform rate usage, memory count, and health. Same shape the CLI statusline composes — built for veto-vscode and other editor integrations.

tool_signatures.name: veto_sre_advisor
tool_signatures.description: Calculates SLO error budget status (remaining %, projected exhaustion) and returns ranked reliability improvements. Error budget math is deterministic; prioritization uses the local agent loop.

tool_signatures.name: veto_status
tool_signatures.description: Returns Veto server status, version, and database info. Pass token_count to trigger auto-save if context usage crosses 70%.

tool_signatures.name: veto_summarize
tool_signatures.description: Generates a concise expert briefing of a project, directory, or file. Use at the start of a session to orient yourself on unfamiliar code. Returns bullet-point summary, key components, tech stack, and entry points. Faster and higher-level than veto_explain.

tool_signatures.name: veto_task_parse
tool_signatures.description: Parses a plain-English project description or PRD into a structured task DAG with dependencies, complexity scores, priorities, and suggested agent assignments. Feeds directly into veto_workflow.

tool_signatures.name: veto_test_gaps
tool_signatures.description: Reads a coverage report (lcov/JSON) or scans source files to identify untested paths and suggests concrete test cases.

tool_signatures.name: veto_translate
tool_signatures.description: Translates text or structured i18n files (JSON/YAML) to target languages while preserving variables and formatting.

tool_signatures.description: Counts explicit

tool_signatures.name: veto_usage_status
tool_signatures.description: Live AI usage dashboard. Shows tokens consumed today, requests per platform, subscription vs API usage split, 7-day history, and warnings when approaching limits.

tool_signatures.name: veto_watch
tool_signatures.description: Starts a file watcher on a project directory. Returns a watch_id. Call veto_watch_poll to collect file-change events with recommended agents. Call veto_watch_stop when done.

tool_signatures.name: veto_watch_poll
tool_signatures.description: Polls for file-change events from an active watcher. Returns accumulated events since last poll (events are cleared on read). Each event includes the file, recommended agent, and suggested veto tool to call.

tool_signatures.name: veto_watch_stop
tool_signatures.description: Stops an active file watcher.

tool_signatures.name: veto_workflow
tool_signatures.description: Runs a sequential agent pipeline with optional pass/fail gates between steps. Each step runs a worker agent; if a gate score is set and the step confidence falls below it, the pipeline stops. Returns per-step results plus an overall verdict (passed/partial/failed).
